notes: Statement from the CEMC 2024 CCO problem set (Day 1 Problem 3), cross-checked with Luogu P11516. No accepted C++ was collected: the one TLE submission solves the path subtask and an O(N^2) subtask only, and no public full solution was found, so orig.cpp is written here (binary search on the final city, then one reverse-preorder pass with a union-find path minimum; the header comment gives the argument). Checked on both statement samples, on 400 random cases with N <= 10 against an independent exhaustive game search over (city, used roads), and on 200 cases with N <= 1600 against the O(N^2) TLE submission; --max and other N = 300000 shapes run in under 1 s.
